states: Private mock stack (backend :7731, Vite :5251 serving this branch, merged with main 9aaac4d3e5) with Playwright page.clock installed before load and every /api/alerts/deadman/status read held until the script answers it

Reads slower than the poll: each poll starts a read while the previous is pending; answers applied in order (10 mins ago -> 3 mins ago -> 1 min ago), and an older read answered after a newer one did not overwrite it (stayed 1 min ago); every poll tick issued a read (no tick skipped to timer jitter)

A Refresh that never settles, followed by a background read that also never settles: Refresh showed Refreshing… disabled, then was enabled again at the first poll after it had been pending a full interval, and a second Refresh applied the fresh status
Earlier hang case still holds: with a hung background read, Refresh applies the fresh status and the hung read's late 2-hour-old answer is discarded
Control with the previous loader under the running Vite: slow reads never showed a status (every answer discarded) and the hung Refresh stayed disabled
No page errors at either viewport
interactions: Loaded /alerts/destinations at 1440x900 and 390x844, ran the page clock in 30-second steps answering held reads in and out of order
Clicked Refresh with the read held, ran the clock 61 seconds, clicked Refresh again and answered it
Repeated with the previous loader as the control
